title: Kohlrabi in Lemon-Cream Sauce
description: Kohlrabi tastes delicious when cooked in this simple lemon-flavored cream sauce. If you get your kohlrabi from the farmer's market, mix in the leaves in the end as well.
ingredients: 1.5 cups heavy whipping cream, or as needed
3 kohlrabi, peeled and sliced, kohlrabi leaves reserved
2 teaspoons grated lemon zest, or to taste
1 tablespoon lemon juice, or to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring cream to a boil in a medium pot. Add kohlrabi and reduce heat. Cover and simmer until kohlrabi is soft, about 20 minutes.

Remove kohlrabi from sauce and place in a bowl; keep warm. Increase heat and cook sauce until thickened, about 5 minutes. Season with lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and sugar. Stir in parsley. Add kohlrabi, mix to coat with sauce, and serve.
